# Sidebar {.sidebar}

This no-server dashboard reads the cached NHANES Health Equity CSV snapshot in the browser. It is descriptive, unweighted, and intended as a static portfolio extension.

```{ojs}
nhanes = FileAttachment("../../examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv").csv({typed: true})
incomeGroups = Array.from(new Set(nhanes.map(d => d.IncomeGroup).filter(d => d))).sort()
viewof selectedIncome = Inputs.select(["All"].concat(incomeGroups), {
  label: "Income group",
  value: "All"
})
viewof ageRange = Inputs.range([20, 80], {
  label: "Age range",
  step: 5,
  value: [20, 80]
})
```

# Row

## Mean BMI Across Cycle

```{ojs}
filtered = nhanes.filter(d =>
  (selectedIncome === "All" || d.IncomeGroup === selectedIncome) &&
  d.BMI != null &&
  d.Age >= ageRange[0] &&
  d.Age <= ageRange[1] &&
  d.Cycle != null
)

cycleSummary = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filtered,
    rows => ({
      n: rows.length,
      mean_bmi: d3.mean(rows, d => d.BMI)
    }),
    d => d.Cycle
  ),
  ([Cycle, values]) => ({
    Cycle,
    n: values.n,
    mean_bmi: values.mean_bmi
  })
).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.Cycle, b.Cycle))

Plot.plot({
  height: 360,
  marginBottom: 70,
  y: {label: "Mean BMI", zero: true},
  x: {label: "NHANES cycle", tickRotate: -45},
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(cycleSummary, {x: "Cycle", y: "mean_bmi"}),
    Plot.dot(cycleSummary, {x: "Cycle", y: "mean_bmi", r: 4}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Summary Table

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(cycleSummary.map(d => ({
  Cycle: d.Cycle,
  N: d.n,
  "Mean BMI": d.mean_bmi == null ? null : d.mean_bmi.toFixed(1)
})))
```

# Row

## Interpretation Note

This static dashboard filters the cached classroom dataset by income group and age range. The chart and table show unweighted descriptive summaries only. The static version is useful for portfolios because it does not require a running Shiny server, but it does not replace a documented report or survey-weighted analysis.
